title: Knicks Champions: Who's Rising and Who's Falling After the Title Run
description:
For the first time since 1973, the Larry O'Brien trophy sits in Madison Square Garden. But a championship changes how we see every player on the roster. Who's rising, who's falling — and who is playing backup center?

Narration is AI-generated. All commentary and analysis is original.
